texts.facts: This Writ Petition has been filed to direct the respondents not to interfere with the petitioner firm's functioning of restaurant along with herbal hookah services (0% tobacco & 0% nicotine) with all required statutory licenses, under the guise of incessant inspection during the working hours thereby infringing their right to do a legal business guaranteed under Article 19(1)(g) of the Constitution by considering the petitioner representation dated 18.08.2025. 2. The case of the petitioner is that the petitioner is running a restaurant under the name and style of M/s.Deja Brew Care after obtaining required licenses. It is further stated that a separate earmarked smoking area has been provided for serving herbal flavour hookah without any content or traces of Tobacco or Nicotine. The petitioner has also obtained license from FSSAI on 04.12.2024 which is valid up to https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 16/09/2025 04:41:11 pm ) 03.12.2025. According to the petitioner, the respondents have been frequently interfering with the petitioner's business under the guise of inspection during business hours and disrupted the functioning in front of the customers. Hence, the present petition has been filed. 3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the third respondent police for conducting periodical inspection of the petitioner firm. 4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents filed a Counter Affidavit. 5. In the counter statement, it is specifically denied that the respondent police had caused any disturbance to the petitioner's business. It has been stated that earlier, the petitioner had filed a Writ Petition in W.P.No.39716 of 2024 seeking to forbear the third respondent police herein from interfering in relation to the running of their restaurant in which, this Court by order dated 27.12.2024 had passed the following order: "4. In view of the said submissions made by either parties, there shall be a direction to the petitioner forthwith to make an application before the Department of Food M/S.Deja Brew Cafe vs The Commissioner Of Police on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168268222/ 2 Safety and obtain an appropriate permission for providing Herbal https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 16/09/2025 04:41:11 pm ) Hookah Services (without any content or trace of tobacco and nicotine). The petitioner shall also give an under taking letter before the respondent police to have separate smoking area for servicing Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine). On receipt of the said undertaking, the respondent police are directed not to interfere with the business premises of the petitioner after getting permission by the Department of Food Safety.
